name: FileDropZone
description: A drag-and-drop file upload zone that also supports click-to-browse. Validates files against an optional accept filter and supports single or multiple file selection.

props.name: onFiles
props.description: Callback invoked with the array of accepted File objects after a drop or file-browse selection.

props.name: accept
props.description: Comma-separated MIME types, wildcard MIME types (e.g. "image/*"), or file extensions (e.g. ".pdf") used to filter dropped and selected files.

props.name: multiple
props.description: When true, allows multiple files to be dropped or selected at once. When false, only the first file is accepted.

accessibility.keyboard: Enter or Space activates the hidden file input to open the file browser dialog.
accessibility.aria: aria-label is set to describe the upload action.
accessibility.notes: The component uses a hidden file input triggered by click or keyboard. The outer div has role="button" and tabIndex={0} for focusability.
